session_unverified: Identity temporarily unverified; current session data remains in memory
uploadPreparation: How your document will be protected
uploadStepHash: Select the file and check its integrity.
uploadStepInitiate: Review the exam details and your consent.
uploadStepTransfer: Send the document privately using temporary authorization.
uploadStepVerify: Complete and check server status before permitting local deletion.
uploadPreparationPending: Uploads are not enabled yet. No document has been selected, sent, or synchronized.
offlineHelp: The interface and previously received data remain in memory during this session. Reading or sending new information requires a connection. No clinical operation queue is enabled.
demoOfflineHelp: You can continue exploring synthetic documents. The installed shell can reopen the demonstration offline; it does not replace the mobile app.
cachedInMemory: Previously received information from this session, not refreshed. No new operation has been confirmed and no persistent clinical copy has been stored.
draftInMemory: This identifier has not been queried yet. It stays in memory only; reloading or signing out discards it.
updateReady: A portal update is ready. Your in-memory work will not be reloaded automatically.
updateConfirm: Updating reloads the portal and discards unsent fields. Continue?
session_error: The provider operation failed; access remains closed
error_400: The server could not accept this request.
error_500: The server encountered an issue. The operation has not been confirmed.
error_timeout: The request timed out. Its outcome has not been confirmed.
demoNotice: Demonstration environment · All documents are synthetic. No real clinical data.
sessionHelp: This backend verifies tokens from an external provider. Identity integration is not configured in this portal yet.
noGrant: Your session does not have the clinical:read permission.
forbidden: This view is unavailable for your role.
overviewSubtitle: Organized documents, clear statuses, and human review at every step.
clinicalSubtitle: Explore an authorized patient's exams and prepare their clinical review.
patientIdHelp: Enter the identifier provided by your platform. The server verifies the clinical relationship.
patientRequired: Enter an identifier of 1 to 200 characters without spaces.
noPatient: Select a patient to view their exams.
examSubtitle: Explore documents and their processing status.
reviewCount: Ready for review on this page
pageOnly: Counts refer to the loaded page, not the complete history.
uploadPending: Web upload will follow identity and signed storage integration. The offline queue belongs to the Flutter client.
clinicalPendingBody: Confirmation, validation, longitudinal tracking, and PDF export will use existing routes. This portal does not calculate scores or diagnoses.
patientPendingBody: Proposal confirmation and upload will become available when their flows are integrated. Patients do not receive scores or clinical interpretation.
emptyBody: No exams were found for this patient with the selected filters.
errorTitle: We could not complete the request
offlineBody: Check your connection. This web portal does not store clinical documents for offline use.
error_0: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and the API URL.
error_401: Your session is invalid or expired. Sign in again through your identity provider.
error_403: The server denied access. Check permissions and the patient relationship.
error_409: The state changed or a conflict occurred. Refresh before trying again.
error_422: The server rejected the submitted parameters.
error_429: The request limit was reached. Wait before trying again.
error_503: A required service is unavailable. Try again later.
error_502: The response does not match the expected contract.
error_unknown: The request failed. Data has not been replaced with a demonstration.
detailNotice: File status and clinical review are different processes. A document ready for review does not imply confirmed or validated results.
catalogSubtitle: Explore the catalog published by the backend. Availability does not establish clinical validation.
serverAuthority: Permissions and the clinical relationship are verified by the server.
configurationError: The portal could not start. Check your local configuration.
